title: TOP: show only the information the user needs at the moment they need it
summary: Add the TOP discipline (show only the information the user needs at the moment they need it) as six candidate rules P32 to P37: show only what is needed now, deliberate tooltips, three information levels, short status text, consequences in the confirmation, and accessibility of minimal interfaces. It generalizes: any application tends to add permanent explanatory paragraphs, tooltips that carry essential facts and stacked actions. Shipped additively outside guidance/: docs/TOP.md and the reusable components in src/ui/top.tsx with a lab page 'Information density'. Open for the owner: new principle versus a revision of P05 and P10 (see conflicts-and-decisions.md). Not an approval.

negative.description: A repository row with a permanent paragraph and six visible buttons (lab page, Avoid column).
A button with a permanent instruction paragraph under it.
negative.snippet: Pressing this button will fetch the latest commits ...

negative.description: A destructive consequence only in a tooltip.

positive.description: A compact row: name, status word, primary action and an overflow menu (lab page, Prefer column).
Consequences in the confirmation, with the exact target in monospace.
positive.snippet: <ConfirmDialog destructive title="Delete local repository?" target="C:\\Projects\\Example" consequences={['Moves the folder to the Recycle Bin']} confirmLabel="Delete repository" />

positive.description: A one sentence tooltip that does not repeat the label.
positive.snippet: <Tooltip content="Fetches, merges, then pushes this branch."><IconButton icon="info" label="About sync" /></Tooltip>
